title: Policy Registration
description: The business's declared enforcement posture for one repository, per environment cell, on the protected default branch under CODEOWNERS (ENFORCEMENT_TIERS_AND_FINDING_BASELINE.md sections 4 and 10; SINGLE_PIPELINE_TARGET.md stage 1). The rung sits ABOVE policy_mode, team_pattern and environment_tier: policy_mode is DERIVED from it and never written here; the tier and the team pattern are read from here and never from a workflow input. Read by scripts/policy_registration.py from a git ref only -- a registration read from the PR under evaluation is a self-signed demotion. Every number the design calls a placeholder lives under `numbers`; the mechanism holds no constant for any of them.

repository.description: Optional human label. The repository is the one the file is committed in; nothing is resolved from this field.

team_pattern.description: Changes HOW a floor is satisfied, never WHETHER. solo_dev makes approval separation an unvalidated human-workflow path -- reported as such, never as passing.

numbers.description: Policy, not architecture (capability_origin.OVERLAY_SPECIFIC_POLICY). Every value here is a placeholder the design refuses to make a constant; a number the mechanism needs and does not find here is POLICY_NUMBER_NOT_CONFIGURED, never a default.

promotion_consecutive_clean_runs.description: ETFB 4.3 item 1: consecutive runs at baseline strength with no EVIDENCE_UNTRUSTED before crawl -> walk.

sla_period_days.description: ETFB 8.2: the remediation term per effective severity. The owner's numbers are recorded as the configured value.

breach_grace_days.description: ETFB 8.5: the grace between a breach and REOPENED_BY_LAPSE. CRITICAL: none; longer severities: short and configured.

track_stall_period_days.description: ETFB 8.8 rule 5: a cell whose track recorded zero verified closures in this period owes a decision at promotion review.

no_fix_recheck_days.description: ETFB 8.7: how often NO_FIX_AVAILABLE must be re-established. Tied to the SLA period by policy; configured here.

severity_formula_version.description: ETFB 6: the version of the severity derivation this cell runs. A change is a declared event with a reconciliation obligation.

environments.description: One cell per environment the repository deploys to. Monotone along the promotion path: rung(sandbox) <= rung(dev) <= rung(test) <= rung(uat) = rung(prod).

rung.description: The DECLARED rung: the target. The effective rung follows promotion_evidence and may be lower; the record carries both and the gate obeys the effective one.

review_trigger.description: ETFB 10: returns to review when the environment set, the team pattern or the exposure changes.

reachable_from_merge_without_human_gate.description: ETFB 4.1: a pull request is evaluated at the rung of the highest environment the merged branch can reach without a further human gate.

promotion_evidence.description: ETFB 4.3. Evidence REFERENCES, never booleans: configuration is not evidence.

history.description: ETFB 4.2: promotions and demotions, prior values retained, never overwritten in place. A demotion additionally requires a reason, an authority and an expiry, or it is WEAKENING_UNATTRIBUTED on every affected run.

cherry_picks.description: ETFB 2: strengthen only. A pick below the rung floor is a policy defect that fails the policy check by name. `control` is a control class (secrets, new_critical_high, pre_existing_on_track, pre_existing_track_lapsed, other_findings) or a named control (a scanner job).

authority.description: A role. Security where the pick is not a strengthening; automatic where it is.

requires_human_control.description: ETFB 4.3 item 4: a pick needing a human control the team pattern cannot provide is recorded as an unvalidated human-workflow path, never as passing.
